findings.finding: pci_domain_id_nv absent in current PyOpenCL/NVIDIA implementation
findings.action: Keep existing strict identity fallback. Do not invent a PCI domain when its query is unavailable.
findings.qualification: Parent performed the live query; this file records the received team evidence rather than claiming an independent local probe.
findings.illustrative_verification_query: import pyopencl as cl; print({name: getattr(cl.device_info, name, None) for name in ('PCI_DOMAIN_ID_NV','PCI_BUS_ID_NV','PCI_SLOT_ID_NV')}); print([(d.name, getattr(d,'pci_domain_id_nv',None),getattr(d,'pci_bus_id_nv',None),getattr(d,'pci_slot_id_nv',None)) for p in cl.get_platforms() for d in p.get_devices() if 'NVIDIA' in d.vendor])

findings.finding: Corruption selects a device boundary rather than first vendor boundary
findings.action: Grok exact patch requested for vendor-aware boundary selection and GPU-free discriminator tests. Same-vendor-only corruption must refuse.

additional_lead_confirmed_patch_target: Unknown or nonpositive maximum allocation size currently disables largest-buffer admission checks; Grok patch must refuse before native allocations.
primary_source_caution: The 2009 Khronos NVIDIA extension text is not sufficient to characterize the current installed PyOpenCL/NVIDIA extension constants. Its absence of current PCI entries does not prove runtime attribute absence.
